'''Butch Branscome''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Bravo 12 from Charlotte, NC. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run. At DecipherCon 1999 Butch also played [[Young Jedi]]: finished 17 in YJ Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck); finished 11 in YJ Qualifier; finished 14 in The Gauntlet Dual Formats.<ref name="dc99yj02_2">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier #2 (Sealed Deck)], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010108185300/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ02_2.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99yj03_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ03_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: YJ Qualifier], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001205134500/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ03_1.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="dc99yj30_1">[http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ30_1.html DecipherCon 1999 – Event Scores: The Gauntlet Dual Formats], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001119215300/http://decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/deciphercon/events/scores/YJ30_1.html Internet Archive]</ref>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.
